stemMd:
A museum displays a repaired instrument beside a diagram showing which pieces are original and which were replaced. Visitors can hear the instrument played while also seeing how much intervention was needed to make that possible. The display treats performance and material history as related questions rather than forcing one to conceal the other.

Which choice best states the main idea?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The display combines functional restoration with transparency about the object's altered material history.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Playing an instrument always destroys its historical value.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The instrument has never been repaired.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The museum hides all replacement pieces from visitors.

explanationMd: The display enables performance while documenting intervention. Its point is to make both the restored function and the surviving evidence legible, not to choose one by concealing the other.

distractorRationale.b: The text presents a way to address both concerns.
distractorRationale.c: Repair is central to the display.
